{{Quote|We came seeking knowledge of the Jedi Code. The Flesh Raiders interrupted our trial.''"<br />"''Never fought like that in my life. We killed it, but Jerridan was badly injured.|Mennaus and Avitla|audio=Mennaus-Avitla-Fought-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Avitla''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who undertook her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], she accompanied fellow Padawans [[Mennaus]] and [[Jerridan]] to the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] to seek knowledge of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]], but they were [[Flesh Raider uprising|interrupted]] by [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s.

The trio fought and [[Death/Legends|killed]] one Flesh Raider, although Jerridan was badly wounded. Although Avitla wished to keep fighting till the group's trial was finished, another Padawan arrived and told them to return to safety, giving them a [[Signal beacon/Legends|signal beacon]] to summon a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|But we're so close to finishing the trial&hellip;''"<br />"''No. We are not. I see you have a signal beacon. Leave it for us, and as soon as we have gathered our things, we will signal for a ride back.|Avitla and Mennaus|audio=Avitla-Mennaus-LightSide-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:SurprisedFleshRaider-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A dead Flesh Raider lays splayed in the grass of the Tythonian Gnarls.|Avitla, Mennaus, and Jerridan managed to kill a Flesh Raider.]]
Avitla was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Avitla was [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. As part of her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], she accompanied fellow Padawans [[Mennaus]] and [[Jerridan]] into the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region to seek knowledge of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]].<ref name="TOR" />

The trio's trials were interrupted when they were [[Flesh Raider uprising|attacked]] by Tython's native [[Flesh Raider]]s. Having not received combat training, the three Padawans fought a lone Flesh Raider near the [[Tythos River Delta]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them, although Jerridan was badly injured during the battle. While Mennaus tended to Jerridan's injury, Avitla suggested they keep fighting until their trials were complete. Mennaus disgreed, but confirmed that he could help Jerridan along if Avitla was determined to keep going.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
[[File:EarlyLessons-PadawanTrio-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Avitla stands over a wounded Jerridan while Mennaus kneels beside him in the Tythonain Gnarls.|Avitla wished to keep fighting despite Jerridan's injury.]] 
While Mennaus tended to Jerridan, they were approached by a Padawan who had been sent to find them by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relnex]], a watchman at the nearby [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi training grounds]]. Avitla and Mennaus explained their situation and Avitla asked the Padawan to aid them in fighting the Flesh Raiders. The Padawan refused and told the three Padawans that they needed to return to safety, giving them a [[Signal beacon/Legends|signal beacon]] that Relnex had provided so that they could summon a rescue [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] for transport out of the Gnarls. Avitla was angered by this given how close she felt they were to the end of the trial, but Mennaus persuaded her to accept their best chance at survival and took the beacon.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Training or not, a bunch of animals won't keep us from becoming Jedi.|Avitla|audio=Avitla-Animals-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Avitla considered the Flesh Raiders animals and was angered by their attack, determined to seek vengeance and push on to finish her trials despite Jerridan's injuries. Confident that she and her colleagues could take on the Flesh Raiders, she believed that Jedi never gave up and that even if she, Mennaus, and Jerridan did die, that they would do so with pride. Avitla had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dark skin.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|How's he looking?''"<br />"''He should be resting in the Jedi Temple. But if you're determined to press on&hellip; I can help him along.''"<br />"''Give him the last of the kolto if you have to. We'll fight again soon.|Avitla and Mennaus discuss Jerridan|audio=Avitla-Mennaus-Kolto-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
While in the Gnarls, Avitla wore yellow and brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] with a white trim as well as a white sash [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. She carried a [[Lightsaber training staff|training saber]] and had access to medicinal [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Here's what we need, then&mdash;if you can take the Flesh Raiders head-on, we can come around and flank them. When you're finished, let the watchman at camp know we're coming back. It just may take us a while&hellip;|Avitla's dialgoue if players chose the Dark Side option and helps her|audio=Avitla-DarkSide-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Avitla appeared in the quest "Early Lessons" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Only players of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] or [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] class may take the quest and refusing to aid the Padawans in fighting the Flesh Raiders is considered the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] option. While this article assumes players took the Light Side option, there is also the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] option to agree to help Avitla by taking on the Flesh Raiders head on while Avitla, Mennaus, and Jerridan flank them. Choosing this options leads to the player killing ten Flesh Raiders and destroying three sets of their supplies. When the player reports this to Relnex they can warn the watchman that the trio of Padawans will be coming back angry.<ref name="TOR" />
